final.title: AIW round 10: declared line bundles in the one notation engine and wires drawn once in the chapter views. Fewer lines and marks; every relationship stays its own record, hit, Tab stop and reading (target AIW v0.10.0-rc.10.73.15, candidate)
final.rationale:
The spine is the engine proposal. It was the only one prototyped in production shape: scratch exp/public/notation-layout.js, notation-svg.js and notation-metrics.mjs, which passed every notation unit suite and 8 browser suites. It is also the only proposal all three lenses scored 8.

It fixes noise at its two measured roots in the shared engine, so the Diagram, the Layers view, the SVG/PNG export, the SDD figures, the record picture, the Running board and the perspectives improve together:
- The snap defect leaves jogs on 72% of edges.
- The one-port-per-end rule turns same-style fans into ribbons with stacked heads. Fans hold 52.8% of bank-payment's Diagram edges.

Measured on the 88 routed reference Diagram defaults: heads 1,245→1,056, distinct visual crossing points 768→590, ink −6.2%, bends −44%, short jog segments −87%, foreign shared runs 19→5, 0 fallbacks. On bank Ch6 Solution: heads 32→14 and crossing points 114→68.

Grafts from the other proposals, each kept because a judge listed it as a must-keep:
- From reader:
  - the UML 2.5.1 shared-target T-join with no dot for composition and aggregation, extended to the kinds that already use a dot end marker (protects, evidences, hosts, standsOn);
  - a screen-only lift layer that draws selected, lit and traced routes whole and on top;
  - a companion hover reading for relationships and lines;
  - the camera following keyboard focus (WCAG 2.4.11);
  - CSS-only line, join and hit widths that follow zoom;
  - forced-colours rules;
  - the Key wording 'each branch is one recorded relationship'.
- From semantic:
  - exactness checked as a property, which becomes the bundleIntegrity suite;
  - a drawing note in every member's aria-label and title;
  - Key marks shown only when their form is drawn;
  - a visual-only 'Also recorded as' for duplicate records.
- From views:
  - the whole chapter-view lane: a pure wire-merge module that shares ink only among identically styled links, a crossing-aware track assigner, Ch9 entry trunks drawn once, Ch2 and Ch3 combs, the Ch3 track order and port rule, Ch1 fan-out trees, Ch10 'needs' rails, Whole design spines, token-filled heads and relative chapter evidence;
  - continuous stroke-dashoffset from the bundle root, which makes the engine's 'dashes in phase' claim true across joins.

Judge corrections built in:
- bundleIntegrity gains two checks the engine missed: a foreign line within 3 px of a join, and a foreign corner lying on a trunk. I re-ran the judge script and confirmed 7 and 6 such cases in the prototype's Layers pictures.
- Bundles that use the T-join must split only as a T, never as a 4-way node.
- Tuning becomes frozen constants. The prototype read process.env.R10_*.
- Layers relayout gets an early bail-out and a budget, because the fallback path was 2.4× slower.
- Duplicate merging is excluded from BPMN lanes and process pictures.
- The sharedRuns exemption applies only to bundles that pass integrity.
- Dark-theme state tokens are ones that pass 3:1: gold-11, violet-11, green-11, gold-9 and sage-9. The reader and semantic proposals' token sets fail for 4 of 5 states.
- Culling is re-checked.
- The test re-specifications (notation-browser-validate:67, story-browser-validate:144) become stronger, never looser.
- Before and after screenshots must be inspected and logged. Two prototype shots this round were defective: the Ch10 rails left dots floating, and the Ch1 'exact' bus implied ACT-003→JRN-003.

Dropped with reason:
- Semantic's model-level fact merge: it changes D counts and drops records from the Layers code exports.
- Junction items inside the arrangements: unprototyped production form, +34% page width.
- Dashed same-relationship frames: they read as ArchiMate Grouping.
- Nesting by default.
- pointer-events:none on member hits.
- Reader's roving tabindex and branch-only hits: they change the keyboard contract.
- Counted pills: they hide lines at rest in the SDD.
- Receding headless lines and heavier trunks.
- Views' 'most established member' style rule and biclique buses.
- Frozen golden ceilings.
- Engine's exposed 'Join lines' toggle: an export would depend on a per-reader preference. consolidate stays one internal notationLayout option, used for the control and the fallback.

How the judges were weighed:
- Judge 1 (truth) acts as a veto on anything that implies or hides a relationship.
- Judge 2 (engineering) acts as a veto on the D/L/DOM/export contracts, determinism and budgets.
- Judge 3 (standards and accessibility) governs glyphs, exclusions, tokens and keyboard access.
- Where they differed, the stricter rule wins. Examples: trunk state is derived per run, so selection lights exactly the selected route; the lift is screen-only; buses are deferred.

Honest scope: this round cleans the routed pictures. The straight-mode giants keep their 1:1 lines and are reported unchanged. These are by-layer pictures above 160 edges or 120 nodes, and any picture above 400 edges; 77.5% of all crossings sit in the noisiest 10% of pictures, and scale Ch3 Rationale alone has 99,977. Summarising them changes the picture contract, so it is an owner decision for a later round.
principles: A picture is a reading, never a fact. Consolidation merges ink, never records. One D.edge stays one L.edge (full pts, in D order), one g.nt-edge[data-nt-edge], one full-route .nt-hit with its own Tab stop and aria-label, one companion reading and one connection in every code export. No bundle id ever reaches draw.io, the ArchiMate exchange, BPMN DI, Structurizr, PlantUML or Mermaid.

Ink is shared only along a declared tree from one shared element and one side of it. The relationships on it must be drawn identically: kind (therefore ArchiMate type), word, ends, weak, reply, diff change, and the qualifier where it sits at the shared end. No link belongs to two structures. Relationships that do not share an endpoint never share ink, so the D2-12 bus cannot return.

Every bundle is validated. A bundle that rides a foreign line along its trunk, passes a foreign line through or near a join, has a foreign corner on its trunk, rejoins itself, crosses an element, or (for T-join kinds) splits four ways is repaired locally or drawn apart as snapped separate lines. It is never drawn as a bus, and every fallback is recorded.

No implied semantics. No joins on ArchiMate Flow or Triggering relationships (flow, transforms, message, path, sequence, transition, plus selects by family), in BPMN lanes or process pictures, in sequence pictures, or on numbered, cardinality or crossing-marked edges. Composition and aggregation split as a plain T under one diamond. The Key makes no ArchiMate junction conformance claim until an independent reviewer has checked the 3.2 §5.5 text.

One engine, one renderer, one entry point. The changes live in public/notation-layout.js and public/notation-svg.js, so every consumer improves at once. consolidate is a single option on notationLayout, used for the in-run control and the fallback, not a parallel path. The chapter views share one pure wires module instead of five copies of interval colouring and four copies of roundPath.

Deterministic geometry. Layout depends on no zoom, viewport, selection, lens or environment variable. Exports are byte-identical at any window width and in light and dark. SDD figures equal fresh renders. Only CSS weight and visibility follow zoom.

Disclosure without moving anything. Hover, focus, selection, trace and the lift layer reveal a relationship's full route, trunk included. Trunk state is derived per run (sel or lit when any member travelling the run is, dim only when every member is), so a selection lights exactly its own route and never a co-member's branch.

State stays visible in every theme. The round-9 dark regression is fixed with token rules that meet 3:1 on the night canvas. Trunks, joins and the lift recolour with the lines, and non-colour cues are kept: width, end rings, dashes, separate weak and plain bundles.

Evidence over claims. Gains are measured on real pictures against a consolidate:false control computed in the same run, using stated metric definitions: heads drawn, line ends, ink, distinct visual crossing points, bends, foreign-on-trunk, foreign-at-join, T-contacts, fallbacks and ms. Fallbacks are named, screenshots are inspected and logged, and tests only get stronger.

Honest scope and governance. Straight-mode giants are explicitly unchanged this round. Owner acceptances are recorded as pending until given. No external authority (ArchiMate reviewer, production acceptance) is impersonated, and productionAccepted stays false.

workstreams.mechanism:
notation-layout.js imports styleOf from the import-free notation-palette.js.

Units:
- Exact duplicates are keyed by from|to|kind|label|ends|weak|reply|change|qualifier, members sorted by id, representative = smallest id. They are eligible in every family outside the excluded arrangements and scenes, because no fork is implied.
- Fan keys: fan-in 'i|to|face|lineStyle'; fan-out 'o|from|face|lineStyle', only without a qualifier. lineStyle = kind, label, ends, weak, reply and change.

Greedy assignment is deterministic: score = size × (2 if a marker sits at that end), ties to the smaller key so fan-in comes first, minimum 2, one bundle per unit. Each bundle is therefore a tree from one shared end, never confluent.

Ports: the slot list collapses by merge key at the shared end, sorted by mean far-end centre then id, so a picture without bundles keeps today's order.

Grid and search:
- The grid replaces the used bits with Uint16 counts uh/uv plus bh/bv.
- Along-cost is AVOID=300 when the router is a member or the cell carries a bundle, else 40.
- A member subtracts its own bundle's earlier counts and prefers those cells during its search.
- A 2-cell stem at the shared end.

consolidate() runs after the per-edge loop:
- Member paths are oriented from the shared end. Pairwise LCP gives runs keyed by (member set, start) and joins at splits.
- Validation is bundleIntegrity from N1, including foreign-at-join, T-contact and, for undotted bundles, no 4-way split.
- Repair order: re-route the offender once with along-cost 4000 on bundle cells; else drop the failing members; else ban the key.
- At most 3 incremental passes, keeping every unchanged route.
- Early bail-out: if pass 1 fails on more than 25% of bundles, go to a duplicates-only pass, then a pass with no bundles. The fallback is recorded.
- dotted = not (Composition or Aggregation, or a 'dot' head or tail).

Tuning is a frozen BUNDLE object {MIN:2, ROOT:10, PASSES:3, AVOID:300, STEM:2, BAIL:0.25, RUN:6, JOIN_CLEAR:3}, with no process.env or globalThis reads.

Output contract (beside, never instead of, today's L):
- each member gains bundle, bundleEnd ('to'|'from'|'both') and branch;
- L.bundles=[{id 'B:'+key, end, node, face, kind, family, label, dotted, members (D order), runs:[{members, pts, root, far, offset}], joins, root}];
- L.consolidation={bundles, members, duplicates, joins, passes, dissolved, fallback: false|'duplicates'|'none', why (bounded)}.

notationLayout({consolidate=true}); consolidate:false is today's behaviour plus the snap (the control). The comments at :547-551 and :619-620 are rewritten: connectors never share a start or end, except inside a declared, validated bundle.

Layers tuning attempt (judge 1): for bank Ch5 and Ch6, try formation order, per-face exclusivity and AVOID. Keep only changes that hold every gate, and record the outcome.

workstreams.mechanism:
Trunk groups are emitted inline in the edges part, so every composer gets them without code changes. Per bundle:
- one top-level <g class='nt-bundle' data-nt-bundle=ID>, which bounds the growth in cull units to one per bundle;
- inside it, one <g class='nt-trunk nt-e-KIND nt-f-FAMILY [weak][reply][sel|lit|dim][change][nt-mk-lit|nt-mk-dim]' data-nt-members='ids'> per run, holding path.nt-line with the palette stroke attribute and dash.

Run details:
- Each run is drawn oriented away from the shared end, with stroke-dashoffset equal to its arc-length distance from the root, so dashes are continuous across joins. Markers use orient=auto-start-reverse (notation-palette.js:179).
- The shared-end marker sits only on the root run; for 'both', both markers sit on the single far run.
- Dotted bundles get circle.nt-join r 2.4 in the line colour, inside the run with the largest member set. Undotted bundles get no circle.
- Run state is derived: sel if any member travelling it is selected; lit if any is lit; dim only if all are dim; nt-mk-lit if any; nt-mk-dim only if all. Change and weak are uniform by key.

Each member keeps:
- its <g class='nt-edge ...' data-nt-edge=ID data-nt-bundle=ID> with path.nt-line drawing its branch, or d='' when empty;
- only its far-end marker, its word, qualifier, cardinality and cross;
- its .nt-hit with the full-route d, role=button and tabindex=0. Its aria-label and title are describeEdge plus a drawing note: 'Drawn on one line with N other <kind> relationships to/from <node>.' For a duplicate: 'Recorded more than once; this record: <record>.'

After all member hits, each fan bundle gets one path.nt-bhit (all runs, pointer-only, aria-hidden, no tabindex, data-nt-select=shared node) with a <title> listing its members. 'both' bundles get none.

Other renderer changes:
- In export mode the root run carries a <title> listing members.
- SVG_STYLE rules are generalised to :is(.nt-edge,.nt-trunk). New rules: .nt-trunk:is(.lit,.sel) .nt-join{fill:#b18d42}; .nt-bhit{fill:none;stroke:transparent;stroke-width:12px;cursor:pointer}; .nt-bhit:hover{stroke:#b18d4233}; and an nt-end ring (stroke #b18d42, width 2) on the two ends of a selected relationship.
- liftSVG(D, L, ids, opts) is exported and returned as an interactive-only 'lift' part: <g class='nt-lift' aria-hidden='true'> holding the full pts of sel, lit and nt-mk-lit relationships in state colour, pointer-events none. It is never in an export.

Key and packet:
- legendData(D, L=null) adds marks only when drawn. 'bundle': 'One line for relationships of one kind to or from one element; a dot marks where each leaves it, and each branch is one recorded relationship. A drawing join: AIW does not claim it as an ArchiMate junction.' 'tree': 'Composition, aggregation, assignment, protects and evidences fans share one end mark and split as a plain T.' 'duplicate': 'One line for a relationship recorded more than once; the reading lists each record.'
- keySVG draws a T-join with a dot, a plain T, and a '×2' line.
- notationSVG passes L.
- explainDiagram edges gain bundle {id, end, with}, and measures gain consolidation {bundles, joins, duplicates, fallback}; never pts.
- diagramText is unchanged, so every relationship stays in the alt text.
workstreams.reader_effect: Each trunk is drawn once: dashes in phase, no overdraw, no darkening from stacked opacities. One head or diamond sits at the shared end, with a dot where each relationship leaves, or a clean T for structural fans. Hovering or focusing a member shows its whole route. The printed SDD carries exactly the picture at rest, and the Key explains the new marks in one sentence each.
acceptance: The exported SVG is byte-identical at 1000 and 1440 px. Light and dark exports are byte-identical with no var(--. SDD figures equal fresh notationSVG renders and are inspected by eye after regeneration.

In every picture the count of g.nt-edge[data-nt-edge] and of .nt-hit both equal D.edges.length. Each .nt-hit d equals pathD of its L.edge pts. No .nt-trunk or .nt-bundle carries the nt-edge class or data-nt-edge. The first .nt-hit in DOM order is a relationship.
Markers drawn in the DOM equal N3's drawnMetrics markers (for example Ch6 Solution 14).
Zero 'B:' substrings in draw.io, ArchiMate exchange (views and relationships), BPMN DI, Structurizr, PlantUML and Mermaid outputs. explainDiagram has one entry per D.edge and no positions.

Key: 'bundle' appears if and only if a dotted fan bundle is drawn, 'tree' if and only if an undotted one is, 'duplicate' if and only if a 'both' bundle is. The texts contain 'each branch is one recorded relationship' and 'does not claim it as an ArchiMate junction'.

judgements.lens: ARCHITECT'S CLARITY AND TRUTH. Does the consolidated picture read faster and mor
must_haves: One relationship stays one D.edge and one L.edge with its full pts, in D order. Consolidation merges ink, never records. Code exports stay one relationship and one connection per relationship, with no bundle or junction ids.

A shared stroke carries only relationships that share one end element and one side of it, and that are drawn identically: kind, label, ends, weak, reply, diff change, ArchiMate type, and the qualifier where it sits at the shared end.
Every bundle is a tree from its shared end. No link belongs to two structures, and sharing at both ends is forbidden unless an exact-biclique form is explicitly approved by the owner.

Per-bundle validation dissolves the bundle locally when an unrelated relationship runs collinear with any trunk run (more than 6 px; target 0 foreign-on-trunk in every picture, Layers included), when branches rejoin, or when anything passes through an element. A failed bundle is drawn apart, never as a bus.

Join glyphs appear at every split and nowhere else. No foreign line passes within about 3 px of a join, and no foreign corner lies on a trunk run (T-contact). Add both to bundleIntegrity: the engine prototype has 7 and 6 such cases.

The join glyph cannot be confused with an end marker (the protects and evidences dot head, the hosts and standsOn dot tail). Composition and aggregation get a T-join with no ArchiMate junction dot, or nesting if the owner approves.

Excluded: Flow and Triggering kinds (flow, transforms, sequence, transition, message), numbered paths, sequence pictures and BPMN lanes, so that no fork or AND-join is implied. Exact duplicates may merge in every family, with no junction.

Every relationship stays individually discoverable: its own full-route hit and title, keyboard reachable (one Tab stop each unless the owner changes it), a companion reading that names its co-members, and 'Also recorded as' for merged duplicates. A trunk click never silently picks one member.

Selection, trace and diff show exactly the selected relationship's full route, trunk included, and never light a co-member's branch. State stays visible in the dark theme (fix the theme-ui.css:44-82 specificity defect).
Fan-in bundles draw one head at the shared end and one word. Qualifier-bearing fan-outs are not bundled. Words stay readable (labelOnLabel 0).

The Key, in export, SDD figure and companion, explains every new mark in one plain sentence ('each branch is one recorded relationship'). It shows only when the mark is drawn and makes no ArchiMate conformance claim until a qualified reviewer has checked the 3.2 text.
Geometry is deterministic and independent of zoom, viewport and selection. Screen, export and SDD figure are one picture, byte-identical at any window width.

Evidence is measured on the real pictures with stated metric definitions: distinct visual crossing points, heads drawn, ink, foreign-on-trunk, foreign-at-join, bends and fallbacks, per picture against a consolidate:false control. Before and after screenshots, light and dark, must be inspected; two prototype shots in this round were defective.

The Layers views and the giants are explicitly addressed or explicitly declared out of scope: that is where 77.5% of crossings live. Dense Layers pictures must not silently fall back to nothing while the report claims improvement.
red_lines: Any ink shared between relationships that do not share an end element, or an unrelated line riding along a trunk (the D2-12 bus). The reader prototype does this 37 times on bank Layers Ch5.

Near-biclique buses, lane-pair or group-pair count bands, or any form that states pairs exist without showing which. The same applies to an 'exact' bus drawn so that it visually passes rows it does not serve (the views prototype implies ACT-003→JRN-003).
Joins or junctions on flow, triggering, sequence, message, transition or BPMN flows: they imply forks or synchronisation that the model does not record.
An ArchiMate And-junction glyph or claim on composition or aggregation, or a Key that claims ArchiMate conformance before the standard text has been checked.
Merging different kinds, words, weak or strong lines, diff states, or proposed and recorded states onto one stroke, or hiding a member's distinct state on a shared portion.
Deleting or merging relationships in D to make a picture cleaner without owner approval, or a model-level merge that drops a differing qualifier.
A frame or container glyph that reads as an ArchiMate Grouping or the app's own groups, and so implies containment that is not recorded.

Relationships hidden at rest in routed pictures that print in the SDD (faded headless lines, lines shown only on hover). Straight-mode summaries are allowed only with every member listed in print and owner approval.
Geometry that depends on zoom, selection or window width; a screen-only consolidation that the SDD does not carry.
A trunk hit that silently selects one member, or the loss of per-relationship hits, Tab reachability or companion readings.
Reporting gains from prototypes that do not implement the stated exclusions or validation, or citing screenshots that were not inspected.

must_haves: Keep the D contract. D.edges is not merged, dropped or re-keyed by consolidation. Duplicate facts are merged only in L geometry and in the render, so relationship counts, status lines, describeEdge, explainDiagram and the codeFile(D, L) exports stay one per recorded relationship.

Keep the L contract. Exactly one L.edge per D.edge, in D order, each with its full axis-aligned pts from its own element to its own element (radial excepted). Bundle data goes beside it (L.bundles, L.consolidation, e.bundle, e.branch) and never replaces it. notation-layout-validate:212 and process-semantics-validate:247 must hold.

Code exports keep one relationship and one connection per relationship. No bundle, junction or 'B:' id may appear in draw.io, ArchiMate views or BPMN DI. Extend notation-code-validate:51 to assert this. Coincident bendpoints are the only carry-over.

Determinism. Every bundle key is a sorted string with stable tie-breaks. No randomness, no viewport, zoom, selection, lens or env input (remove process.env.R10_* and globalThis.__RF from shipped code). Layout JSON is identical twice and across processes. The export is byte-identical at 1000 and 1440 px. SDD figures equal a fresh notationSVG.

Budgets. Consolidation is off in straight mode (radial, by-layer above 160 edges or 120 nodes, anything above 400 edges) and for sequence, lanes and BPMN. Stress stays under 3 s, synthetic-200 under 8 s, the 305-responsibility by-layer picture under 1.5 s, and scale-500 Ch4 and Ch5 under 1.5 s and still straight. Add an explicit Layers consolidation budget assertion and an early bail-out to duplicates-only.

The D2-12 guard is redefined, not weakened. The sharedRuns exemption applies only to pairs inside a bundle that passes bundleIntegrity, and bundleIntegrity is asserted empty for every scene × arrangement (same kind and style, shared node, the runs form a tree, a join at every split, member pts = runs + branch, no foreign segment along a trunk, root ≥ 10 px). Foreign sharedRuns stay ≤ 3 on every default picture, and the owner's acceptance is recorded with a reference to audit/round2/03_DIAGRAMS.md:59.

Per-relationship DOM. One g.nt-edge[data-nt-edge] per relationship with its own path.nt-line. One .nt-hit per relationship with its full-route d, role=button, tabindex=0 and aria-label=describeEdge, in the single never-culled g.nt-hits, in L.edges order after the nodes. Shared-ink elements never carry .nt-edge or data-nt-edge. Any bundle hit is pointer-only, aria-hidden and placed after the member hits.

State on shared ink is derived: sel or lit if any member is, dim or nt-mk-dim only if every member is. paintMarks repaints trunks through a Map. Add a browser test that a trace lights the trunk; existing tests count only .nt-edge and would miss it.

Dark theme. Fix the round-9 state-colour regression (state rules at specificity 0,6,2 with tokens only), recolour trunks and join dots through [stroke] and [fill] attribute selectors, and mirror everything in the system-dark block. style-tokens-validate passes, and the light and dark exports stay byte-identical.

Land in coherent, separately verifiable commits, each green on its focused suites. Order: metrics (dormant), snap alone, duplicates, fan bundles with integrity and fallback, words, renderer and Key, dark theme, interaction. SDD figure bytes are regenerated and inspected at the step that changes geometry.

Tests change only to become stronger. notation-browser-validate:67 re-specified to read the root-run marker; story-browser-validate:144 changed to the union of data-links. Nothing is deleted or loosened, and the per-kind .nt-edge counts (desk 5/28/5, lifecycle 4, messages) stay exact.

Evidence is relative and machine-readable. Compare drawn metrics against a consolidate:false control in the same run, reporting both segment-pair and drawn crossings, plus bundles, joins, dissolved, fallback and ms per picture. Record it in release evidence that keeps the AIW v0.10.0-rc.10.73.x notation.
The fallback is always a valid, unambiguous picture: separate snapped lines. It is deterministic and recorded in L.consolidation; it never leaves a partial bus.

The Key and the readings make no conformance claim to a standard that nobody has checked. Use 'a drawing join, not an ArchiMate junction' until a qualified reviewer has checked the ArchiMate 3.2 text, and record that dependency honestly.

Check culling after the change. Added trunk groups may push pictures over CULL_FROM=150; check that culled trunks and the never-culled hits container keep keyboard reachability (scale-browser-validate, model-stage refocus).
red_lines: Merging, deleting or re-keying D.edges to consolidate lines (for example semantic C2). It changes counts and drops records from the Layers code exports.
Emitting ArchiMate Junction elements, merged connections or any synthetic bundle or junction id in any code export.
Geometry or bundling that depends on zoom, hover, selection, lens, window width or environment variables.
Sharing ink between relationships that do not share an endpoint (confluent or lane-pair buses), except exact bicliques after explicit owner approval and an exactness gate.

Hiding relationships at rest in exports or SDD figures (counted pills or folds, display:none members, nesting that draws composition only on selection) without an owner decision. This changes the 1:1 picture contract.

Removing direct pointer or keyboard selection of an individual relationship. That includes pointer-events:none on member hits, a member hit reduced to its branch, and a roving tabindex that replaces per-relationship Tab stops without an approved a11y change.
Exempting bundles from sharedRuns without a bundleIntegrity gate asserted on every scene × arrangement, or loosening any existing count or gate to make consolidation pass.
Changing the straight-mode threshold semantics (for example counting drawn lines) without scale budget proof.

Introducing a parallel container or line concept to sidestep an existing assertion (L.nests beside L.groups), or keeping old and new routing paths side by side instead of one consolidate option on notationLayout.
Global re-route passes with a whole-picture fallback that cascades (measured at 361-736 dissolutions).
Shipping prototype tuning knobs (process.env.R10_*, globalThis.__RF) or unbounded search in public/ code.
Claiming ArchiMate or UML conformance for the join glyph, or claiming productionAccepted, without the external review and the evidence that would support it.

judgements.lens: NOTATION STANDARDS AND ACCESSIBILITY. I checked against the source and understan
must_haves: Every relationship keeps its own D.edge, L.edge (full pts), g.nt-edge and focusable .nt-hit. Its aria-label and title are describeEdge, extended with any drawing note ('drawn on one line with N others', or 'recorded twice; this record: X' for duplicates). Enter and Space select it into the companion, and the first .nt-hit in DOM order is a relationship. One Tab stop per relationship stays the baseline; a roving composite is allowed only with a proper ARIA role, screen-reader testing and owner sign-off.

Keyboard focus and pointer hover on a relationship show its complete route, shared trunk included, and a selected or lit relationship is visible end to end. Trunk state is sel or lit if any member is, and dimmed only when every member is.

A click on a shared trunk or junction never silently picks one member; its action (for example selecting the shared element) has a keyboard equivalent, and the companion lists every member as a button.

Ink is shared only by relationships with an identical full style: kind (therefore ArchiMate type), word, dash, head, tail, ends, weak, reply, diff change, validity, and proposed versus recorded state. Fans share exactly one end and form a tree. Sharing at both ends is allowed only for exact bicliques under an explicit owner decision.

Exclusions: any kind whose ArchiMate type is Flow or Triggering (flow, transforms, message, path, sequence, transition, and selects by family), BPMN lanes and process pictures (duplicate merge included), sequence pictures (UML replies and message order kept), and edges carrying a step, cardinality or crossing mark. Straight-mode pictures stay 1:1.

Join glyph: the Key and readings call it a drawing join and make no ArchiMate And-junction conformance claim until an independent reviewer has checked the ArchiMate 3.2 §5.5 text (record that status honestly). Composition and aggregation trees get no filled dot (UML shared-target T-join). The glyph must be distinguishable from a crossing (a mark at every split, or no 4-way split) and from the existing 'dot' end marker (assignment tail; protects and evidences heads). It must stay visible at the first-fit zoom through screen-only CSS.

Dark-theme parity in both the dark and the system-dark blocks: trunks, join dots and shared markers recolour, and the state colours sel, lit, nt-mk-lit, added, removed and changed are restored with tokens that meet 3:1 on the dark canvas (#172024): gold-11, violet-11, green-11, gold-9 and sage-9. Light theme and exports stay byte-identical, with literals only inside [stroke]/[fill] attribute selectors. Chapter-view arrowheads move to token fills.
Non-colour cues survive: selection by width (plus end rings), removed by dash, weak and plain bundles kept apart with separate heads, and no stacked markers.
On screen, the camera reveals keyboard-focused SVG elements and relationships (:focus-visible), so focus is never off stage (WCAG 2.4.11); line and hit widths follow zoom in CSS only.

Governance: bundles and junctions live only in L and the DOM. No model elements, no ArchiMate Junction elements, no 'B:'/'b:'/'j:' ids in any code export. Code exports stay one relationship per relationship. explainDiagram carries no positions, nothing is written to the document, and the Key, status line and aria-label count relationships, not lines.
Determinism: geometry never depends on zoom, selection, lens or window width. The export is byte-identical at 1000 and 1440 px, and SDD figures equal fresh renders.

Evidence: browser assertions for dark state colours (contrast), Tab order unchanged, aria-labels per member, trunk-click behaviour and focus reveal. The redefined D2-12 gate (foreign shared runs ≤ 3) is explicitly accepted by the owner.
red_lines: Shared ink between relationships that do not share an endpoint, unless they form an exact biclique (the D2-12 bus); near-complete bipartite buses or lane-pair count bands.
A filled dot or any junction-like glyph on a split of ArchiMate Flow or Triggering relationships, or on BPMN sequence or message flows: it asserts a gateway the model does not hold.
Calling the join an ArchiMate And-junction in the Key, readings or SDD before an independent reviewer confirms it, or impersonating that reviewer.
A relationship that is reachable only by pointer, or that loses its own aria-label, selection or companion reading; a trunk hit that silently selects whichever member is last in DOM order.
One stroke showing one style for members whose styles differ (proposed or hole drawn as recorded, weak as plain, different kinds or words, different diff states).
Folding UML sequence replies, merging numbered messages, or bundling inside the sequence or BPMN lanes arrangements.
Emitting ArchiMate Junction elements, merged connections or bundle ids in draw.io, ArchiMate exchange, BPMN DI, Structurizr or Mermaid; adding model elements or writing anything to the document.
Geometry or consolidation that varies with zoom, selection, lens or viewport, which breaks byte-identical exports.
Dark-theme state colours that fail 3:1 against the canvas, or states that only change width.
A dashed tabbed frame (ArchiMate Grouping, C4 boundary or AIW external-container look-alike), or nesting that implies a composition or aggregation the model does not record.
Hiding relationship lines by default in standard pictures or SDD figures (pills, receding lines) without an explicit owner decision.
